purpose: One existing post-save split-page observation defect repaired, with a freshly passing font-formatting control; no new API, gate, argument injection, full-189 run or promotion.

repair_hypothesis.description: The preceding focused-font pair recovered Order 62, but Order 61 saved all requested mutations and read both pages separately before repeated false completion rejection. The shared post-save helper kept only the latest page. Merge compatible post-save page observations and distinguish a not-yet-read page from an observed incorrect underline or picture position.
repair_hypothesis.expected_observable_change: Order 61 can satisfy the unchanged completion requirements after model-selected focused reads of all affected pages, with no false demand to repeat verified mutations from an omitted page. It saves, completes and passes the unchanged original evaluator; Order 62 retains its fresh native font-formatting pass.
repair_hypothesis.stop_signal: One fresh guest and one attempt per task with two workers, 100 global steps, 1800 seconds and 30-GiB free-disk stop. Stop after terminal results or existing environment/transport/source limits; a repeated reproduced false-completion loop is an engineering stop. Preserve every attempt and keep source frozen until all exits; no unchanged repeat.
repair_hypothesis.prior_attempt_disposition: Focused-font v1 retained Order 62 passed in 7 events / 244.527 seconds and Order 61 interrupted, unscored in 19 events / 558.163 seconds. The coding agent stopped the repeated demonstrated false rejection, not the user. Both worker final source/config checks passed. No baseline or integrated score is inferred.
repair_hypothesis.focused_verification: The corrected split-read regression fails on the old helper. Current related suites pass 239 tests plus Ruff and diff checks. Offline replay through steps 13/14 retains missing readback, while step 15 satisfies completion with unchanged events. Later page observations replace older ones; save, document and mutation boundaries prevent mixing snapshots.
repair_hypothesis.decoding: Serving settings and existing complete-call stop remain unchanged from the parent pair.

selection.method: Affected Order 61 preserved false rejection after separately reading two saved pages, plus freshly passing Order 62 native font-formatting control.
